text_block_list.text:
In the Japanese Derby, packed with 
formidable rivals, Grass Wonder delivered 
a magnificent result.

I managed to achieve results to be proud 
of. That much is true, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have no right to be satisfied. Not if 
I'm not even at the pinnacle of my 
generation.
choice_data_list:
Let's build up our training again from 
here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't get to give it my all, YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We were able to compete together like this 
in the ultimate ring known as the Derby.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And yet... I... to you...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll be running in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As the one who will prove to be the 
"World's Strongest"! In the only domestic 
GⅠ where overseas Umamusume gather!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So――Grass, please enter too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...To the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Si, exactly! Please participate!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Enter, just one more time!! Please, race 
against me one more time!!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Are you going to run in the "Japan Cup"?
Are you running in the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I hadn't really thought 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Considering gaining experience in the 
Classics, the next step on the royal road 
would be the 'Kikuka Sho'—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Or, considering her aptitudes, she should 
aim for races like the 'Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)'."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? But looking at El-chan, the Japan Cup 
sure looks interesting!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...! Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii♪ Great work, darling♪ That was a 
wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You really caught me by surprise earlier! 
I came to watch my cute juniors' race, and 
you went and made such a fiery declaration 
of war!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You were watching just now, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! The thing is, you see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, El Condor Pasa-chan is a girl 
I've been pretty curious about~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Is that how it is?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because isn't it cute? How she doesn't 
even try to hide her raw fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's true, unexpectedly—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Maybe El-chan is the one who's more like 
a ‘Monster II’♪”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap! I completely forgot I'm on a 
tight schedule.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bye, Grass-chan♪ I'm already looking 
forward to your next race~!

After speaking with Maruzensky, Grass 
Wonder remained silent for a while.
And then, on the way home—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for showing such 
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, my mind was made up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer— Please enter me into the Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“If I cannot even be a ‘Monster II,’ how 
could I ever defeat Maruzen-san?”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I must demonstrate it. My true 
prowess as a "monster."

Bathed in the setting sun, Grass Wonder's 
fighting spirit swelled.

Her next goal has been set... The Japan 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely run ahead of you, 
Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'll burn the sight of my back 
into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how monumental the presence 
reflected in your eyes right now may 
be...!!
